verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with an API and CLI, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API tokens, auth scopes, or agent-specific credentials. The dashboard 'Edit Access' control is a different feature (who can edit a dashboard), not credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
